decisions.reason: The required timing dependency is already fully represented by the candidate's message-92 MODIFY setting toc_page_number_update_timing to after the book size has been fixed.
Fixing the book size before adding Table-of-Contents page numbers does not change Chapter 18 heading typography.
The source establishes the timing of Table-of-Contents pagination, not the inclusion, coverage, or placement of chapter images.
The source does not change image aspect-ratio preservation, cropping, dimensions, or rendering quality.
The publication attribution line remains valid unchanged; the source only concerns when Table-of-Contents page numbers can be added.
The source does not alter image provenance, suitability review, or suitability criteria.
The timing of pagination after trim-size finalization does not affect the approved book-title text constraint.
The source does not change manuscript passages, tracked edits, highlighted additions, or table punctuation.
The source concerns layout sequencing for Table-of-Contents pagination and does not modify copyediting or proofreading requirements.

Although cover production may also depend on book dimensions, the source only states that Table-of-Contents page numbers follow book-size finalization and does not resolve or modify the cover-design requirement.
The source does not change the required back matter or author-biography content.
